Major Duties and Responsibilities: (50%) Incumbent is responsible for the planning, coordinating, execution and evaluation of a comprehensive monthly calendar of reoccurring and non-reoccurring recreational activities, classes, events, trips, and programs.

Recreation activities include but are not limited to special events, seasonal programs, and ongoing daily activities; including instructional classes, contests, trips and tournaments.

Incumbent prepares for these programs by ordering the needed supplies, equipment, transportation, marketing support and making appropriate contacts and arrangements for the success of the programs. Arranges for space set up, audio-visual and other equipment and coordinates with managers when additional staff is needed to make a program successful.

Prepares and provides a detailed program plan that can be given to facilities managers when an activity requires front line staff execution. Decorates and sets up for activities/programs and ensures where activities are held are cleaned up both prior to and after events.

Works closely with Marketing to promote programs that are being planned and implemented. Uses creative techniques to encourage/attract patrons to participate. Coordinates with the installation marketing representative/sponsorship coordinator identifying commercial sponsorship opportunities in support of the program.

(20%) Incumbent captures metrics and evaluates programs. Evaluates effectiveness of program delivery based on user metrics, surveys, interactions with patrons and ICE comments. Uses data to make recommendations and modification to the program. Conducts focus groups in order to determine future programs.

Prepares and submits required monthly reports and metrics for area of responsibility. (5%) Prepares, justifies and monitors the execution of the annual NAF and APF operating budget. Reviews financial reports, compares to budget and provides execution explanation for higher level review.

Researches and prepares purchasing documents in support of equipment/program funding. (5%) Ensures all facilities and activities associated with the program meet established fire, safety, security and sanitation guidelines.

Identifies and communicates repairs related to facility and equipment maintenance deficiencies to the appropriate representatives. Takes timely action to correct deficiencies through coordination with local agencies.

(10%) Incumbent may be required to act in a lead capacity, training, directing and assigning work, preparing work schedules and assisting supervisor with timekeeping responsibilities for Recreation Assistants, Guides, and Motor Vehicle Operators.

Provides necessary on the job training for staff as required and provides input to the manager on employee performance. (5%) Recruits, trains and manages volunteers, special interest groups and interns associated with programs in area of responsibility.

Maintains documentation and ensures procedures are in place for managing special interest groups, volunteers and interns associated with the program.
Knowledge gained through education and training (i.e.

Bachelor's Degree in Recreation, Marketing, Business or closely related field) and/or equivalent recreation related work experience Must be able to utilize a computer and have basic knowledge of software such as Microsoft Office products Combination of experience related to customer service and/or activity based functions Knowledge of recreational programs Knowledge of the goals, principles, techniques and methods of procedures use in organizing, planning and conducting all types of activities.

Ability to create, negotiate, implement and sustain partnerships via various MWR agreements Program planning and leadership skills to devise and implement a leisure and social recreation program Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing

About Sparkify
Sparkify is built by Onstruc UG, a Berlin-based documentation-software company founded in 2020.

Onstruc started out building photo-based documentation tools for the construction trade broadly; about two and a half years ago, the team began focusing that experience specifically on electricians, teaming up with Wiha — a German tool manufacturer with 80 years of history and a genuine fan following in the trade — to build the NFC-enabled hardware integration that's now Sparkify's core differentiator.
Electricians are legally required to document their work — photos, forms, measurement data — after every job; Sparkify replaces pen-and-paper and Excel-and-a-prayer with something that works fully offline in the field, and turns taking a measurement into a tap by pulling data straight off Wiha's testing devices via NFC.
Live for 120 days, we're already at 85+ clients and roughly 125 seats, adding about one new client a day -well financed, growing, and shipping fast with a small senior team. We are looking for someone to take clear ownership of our web platform now: backend, frontend, and the production reality in between.

You take operational ownership of our production system: PHP 8 / Symfony services and a Vue 3 web client used by electricians every day. You keep the system stable, keep billing flowing, and work through a concrete, prioritized bug and feature backlog end to end.
This is a full-stack ownership role in the practical sense: no backend feature is done until the UI exists, and no frontend flow is complete unless the API, data model, and operational behavior behind it work properly.
This is not a greenfield fantasy, but it is not a legacy horror either. It is a clear, manageable production system with real users, real revenue, and real momentum. You will not be alone: our infrastructure partner supports the Couchbase layer, and you will work closely with our founder, who's covering CTO duties directly, so the system becomes better documented and easier to own over time.

Own the Symfony service fleet: API, auth, payment, notification, image, and PDF-report services; Symfony Messenger for async jobs
Own the web client with it: a Vue 3 + Vuetify + TypeScript SPA using Pinia and Vite
Ship features end to end across checkout, billing, workspace, admin, and documentation flows
Build data import/export support as new hardware-manufacturer partners join the platform
Keep billing flowing: Mollie subscriptions, webhooks, invoices, SEPA mandates
Run and improve production infrastructure: Hetzner servers, GitHub Actions CI, SSH deploys, Cloudflare DNS, Pulumi IaC, and observability via Sentry, Datadog, and Grafana
Work through a real backlog: well-defined bugs, missing endpoints, data cleanups, hardening items, and pragmatic product improvements
Get productive with Couchbase and Sync Gateway, which power our mobile sync. Prior Couchbase experience is helpful, but not required; our managed-service partner's Couchbase engineers support us here

At least 5 years ' full-stack engineering experience with strong PHP/Symfony , comfortable owning production systems and being trusted with them
Genuinely comfortable with complex, nested JSON and document-based data modeling — our core datastore is document-based (Couchbase), not purely relational; Couchbase itself isn't required on day one, but this general comfort is
Solid modern frontend skills; our SPA is Vue 3 + Vuetify + TypeScript , and deep Vue experience is ideal
Strong engineers coming from React, Angular, Svelte, or similar frameworks are welcome if they can become productive in Vue quickly
Comfortable with Git submodules and a modular, multi-service repo structure
Excellent English, spoken and written; it is our working language
Good German is a plus
E-commerce or payments experience, for example Mollie, Stripe, or similar, is a big plus
DevOps-capable: comfortable with Linux servers, DNS, CI/CD, and production debugging
Pulumi/IaC experience is a plus
Pragmatic, direct, and able to ship without turning everything into a grand redesign
A friendly environment with a small team of collaborative and innovative people.

Home-office friendly, with an office culture we are actively building and expect people to take part in regularly — this is remote-first, not remote-only: a weekly in-person day and the team's daily video standup are part of the role, not an occasional nice-to-have.
You will work directly with the founder, with fast decisions and very little process theater.
We cover your equipment (Mac, phone, and home-office setup), plus a Deutschland-Ticket on top of salary and a supplementary health allowance (~€600/year).

Who we are
Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched. Tables run every clinical trial, every financial model, every scientific experiment, every business decision, and no one had built a foundation model that truly understood them.
Until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables. The next modality shift in AI is happening, and we're hiring the team that makes it.
Momentum. We pioneered tabular foundation models and are now the world-leading organization in structured-data ML. Our TabPFN v2 model was published as a Nature cover story and set a new state of the art for tabular machine learning.

Since release we've scaled model capabilities 20x+, passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and are seeing accelerating adoption across research and industry - from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi to improving clinical-trial decisions with BostonGene .
The hardest work is ahead. We're scaling tabular foundation models to millions of rows, thousands of features, real-time inference, and entirely new data modalities, while building the infrastructure to run them in production across some of the most demanding industries on earth. These are open problems no one else is working on at this level.
Our team. We're a small, highly selective team of 30+ engineers, researchers, and GTM specialists, with backgrounds spanning Google, Apple, Amazon, DeepMind, Meta, Microsoft Research, G-Research, Jane Street, Goldman Sachs, and CERN. We're led by Frank Hutter , Noah Hollmann , and Sauraj Gambhir , and advised by world-leading AI researchers including Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun. We ship fast, do top-tier research, and hold each other to an extremely high bar.
What's next. In 2025 we raised €9m pre-seed led by Balderton Capital, backed by leaders from Hugging Face, DeepMind, and Black Forest Labs. The next phase of growth is here, which makes this an ideal time to join.

We’re looking for exceptional engineers to help build the ML Platform that powers our tabular foundation model line. This is a unique chance to work at the intersection of data science, agents, UX, and real-world economic impact.

Build the core platform that puts tabular foundation models into users' hands — from data upload and exploration through inference and results

Meet DeepL
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .

s.h: MMeet the team behind this journey
s.t:
DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication . We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.
You will join the API Enterprise team. We sit at the intersection of DeepL's API platform and our Enterprise ecosystem.

Whereas the Core team obsesses over the self-service developer journey, our focus is on enterprise customer adoption: the usage insights, cost controls, RBAC , compliance, and data residency capabilities that enterprise IT and security teams depend on.

We work hand-in-hand with a wide set of stakeholder teams to make DeepL's API the obvious and safe choice for global enterprises.
We are shifting gears. We are moving from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to just close tickets or optimize algorithms in isolation. We hire Missionaries—builders who obsess over the Why before the How.

Drive Enterprise API Adoption: You will own the features that turn enterprise interest into deep, durable adoption. Examples include usage insights, cost and consumption controls, and the governance tooling that lets large organizations understand and manage how they use DeepL's APIs.
Build for Governance & Compliance: You will design the controls enterprise IT and security admins rely on (roles and permissions, projects, data residency, and audit-ability), making DeepL the compliant default for regulated, global organizations.
Guardianship of Quality & Production Reliability: You will own your services end-to-end, including participation in the API on-call rotation, with a shared goal of taking our public API to four nines of reliability. You will implement strong contract testing, monitoring, and SLOs, preventing breaking changes and security vulnerabilities before they reach our enterprise customers.
Architect Across the Enterprise Ecosystem: You will work deep within DeepL's existing technical and organizational structures, navigating dependencies across different areas and many stakeholder teams to ship cohesive, reliable enterprise capabilities.
Qualities we look for
An "Enterprise-First" Mindset: You treat enterprise IT and security admins as your primary users. You understand that earning their trust means clear governance, predictable cost control, robust compliance, fast response times and data residency. You're a strong communicator who's comfortable owning product decisions and implementing them.
Backend Mastery at Scale (C# / .NET): You have deep expertise designing scalable backend systems, RESTful APIs, and distributed architectures, primarily in C# / .NET, and you've worked with high-scale distributed systems in production. Strong API design fundamentals and system design are core to how you work. Roughly 80-90% of the work is backend; working on the frontend (React/TypeScript) is a welcome plus, not a requirement.
Enterprise Platform Fluency: You bring hands-on experience with the building blocks of modern enterprise APIs (MCP, CLIs, and OAuth) and know how to wield them to build secure, extensible integrations.
Cross-Team Leadership: You have a track record of leading projects across multiple teams. You can align with different areas and other stakeholders, manage cross-team contracts and dependencies, and keep complex, interconnected systems coherent.
Extreme Ownership & Operational Excellence: You own your services end-to-end (production operations, incident response, and on-call) and you're motivated by pushing reliability toward four nines. You write comprehensive tests, learn from incidents, and treat mature SLOs as a core engineering feature.
AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery so you can focus your energy on high-value architecture and complex problem-solving.
Bonus points if you have: a track record of zero-downtime migrations on live systems; experience with metering, quota, or usage-data systems; worked in a compliance environment (SOC 2, ISO 27001, C5, or similar)
A Note on Our Hiring Process: DeepL hires for the Company , not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline . If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack.

Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

At VREY , we're building the EnergyOS for multi-family buildings .
Germany has over 3.3 million apartment buildings — and they are the blind spot of the energy transition. <1% solar penetration. <2% smart metering. Almost no flexibility or intelligent energy management.
At the same time, regulation is forcing property owners into major investment: solar is becoming mandatory, smart meters must be rolled out nationwide within five years, heating and mobility are electrifying. The apartment building is transforming from passive real estate into an active part of the decentralised energy infrastructure.
What's missing is an integrated system that makes this transition economically viable and operationally manageable.
VREY combines certified meter operation with proprietary software , enabling property owners to sell self-generated solar power directly to their tenants — simply, and without having to become an energy supplier themselves (§42b EnWG). Regulatory obligation becomes a profitable, predictable opportunity:
Double-digit returns and asset appreciation for owners,
~20% electricity cost savings for tenants, and
digital infrastructure for storage, heat pumps, and flexibility.
We already manage a three-digit number of projects — including some of Germany's largest property holders and housing cooperatives — in all 16 federal states. In the course of our seed financing, we raised €3.3M from leading impact and energy VCs (including Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, and Kopa Ventures). We're now entering the next growth phase and expanding our team.
We're at the beginning of a structural market shift. Join us and help build the leading EnergyOS.
Your Profile
You have 2+ years of professional experience building and running full-stack web applications, ideally with Ruby on Rails . Experience in comparable frameworks (Django, Laravel, Spring Boot, NextJS) will also be considered, if you are truly motivated to learn and work with Rails.
You have a strong understanding and hands-on experience designing and optimizing relational database schemas (we use PostgreSQL ).
You are used to working with APIs and integrating with 3rd-party services.
You have solid experience setting up and maintaining cloud/server infrastructure. We have a basic Heroku setup and Github CI/CD and need to gradually scale and improve monitoring etc.
You have at least basic frontend development skills, ideally with solid fundamentals (HTML, CSS and JavaScript), as well as familiarity with both the Rails way (Hotwire, Turbo and Stimulus) and a framework like React or Vue.
You are actively working with AI and pushing for efficient agentic setups; we are establishing Claude Code in the team and the whole company.
You like to take ownership for the features and components you work on and you are proactive in the product development.
You are excited about startups and want to make a real impact on the product and the company in a truely agile way.
You are based in Berlin (or willing to relocate). You will enjoy working in our office in Friedrichshain with the team most of the time, with the flexibility of 1-2 remote work days a week.
You are willing to learn energy industry terms in English and German and being comfortable with some parts of the company operating mostly in German. (Team language is English.)
Nice to have: You have experience working with multi-tenancy systems and/or are experienced with payment provider integration (e.g., Stripe Connect)

You will be an early member of our growing product development team, working across the entire stack.
The core functionality of the VREY platform is processing smart meter measurement data for analyzing and billing solar power usage. For this purpose, we provide landlords and tenants with a portal and automate contract management, invoicing and payment flows. An admin interface and integration with internal tools enable the creation and management of projects by our operations team.
While working on features and integrations, you also help us improve our infrastructure and backend processes, enabling our platform to scale.
1. Full-stack feature development
You co-design and build features across the full stack, from database to UI.
You work directly with product management, design and internal users to get the details right.
You ensure that our features perform well for a growing number of users.
2. Data processing, automation and reliability
You co-own the development of our crucial backend processes: importing and processing of smart meter measurement data and automated billing.
You help designing and maintaining the underlying server infrastructure.
You instrument, optimize and monitor critical processes so they remain fast, reliable and dependable as we scale.
3. Technical design, architecture and engineering excellence
You research, evaluate and design technical solutions to new problems together with the team.
You contribute to our aspiration to get better and more efficient as engineers and as a team every day.
You continuously improve our development environment and engineering processes, including adopting the right tools, workflows and AI-powered development practices.

Competitive salary including shares based on the level of your experience.
Real ownership: You shape VREY actively from day one. Ownership means responsibility for your tasks end-to-end and the opportunity to take leadership.
Visible impact: We ship features every day that make a difference for our customers and colleagues.
Personal and professional growth: We have very skilled and experienced people on the team that you can learn from and we actively provide opportunities to develop your career.
Making a difference: Our daily work reduces energy costs for tenants, advances the energy transition in residential buildings, and accelerates the economic decarbonisation of Germany's housing stock.
Great workplace: Office in a cool co-working space in Berlin-Friedrichshain, with free drinks, cerials, fruits, and plenty of lunch options nearby.
We're a team that shares lunch, swaps ideas, welcomes new faces regularly, and genuinely listens — come help shape what comes next.
At VREY, we believe that diversity strengthens both our company and society . We do not make hiring or employment decisions based on race, religion, ethnicity, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or age.
Even if you don't meet every requirement, don't hesitate to apply. If you're excited about our mission and believe you can contribute, we want to hear from you!

## Description du poste ##
Intégrez et renforcez une équipe composée de 2 développeurs fullstack et un lead développeur, dont la mission est de poursuivre le développement et l-évolution de l-application Greco, le logiciel de gestion de planning et de téléconsultation utilisé par le personnel.

Le logiciel est également utilisé par les patients et patientes grâce à l-application Concerto. L-équipe travaille de manière agile en s-inspirant fortement de la méthodologie Scrum tout en s-adaptant aux contraintes liées au milieu hospitalier qui impliquent d-être capable de parfois devoir changer rapidement de tâche pour s-adapter aux priorités.
Vous participez à la rédaction des cahiers des charges techniques, en traduisant les besoins fonctionnels en spécifications détaillées. À partir des spécifications techniques, vous développez le logiciel, aussi bien sur la partie front-end que back-end, en utilisant les technologies de pointe et une architecture microservices.

Vous faites évoluer la solution et garantissez sa maintenance, tout en assurant un suivi rigoureux. Concrètement, vous développez en autonomie les fonctionnalités et corrections qui vous sont attribuées.
Grâce à votre esprit d-équipe, vous collaborez étroitement avec l-équipe pour développer des solutions et des fonctionnalités fiables et évolutives. Vous partagez les meilleures pratiques et adoptez une approche critique et constructive dans une optique d-amélioration continue en faisant preuve d-une forte orientation solution.
Tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, grâce à votre sens de la communication, vous contribuez au développement du logiciel de manière optimale et structurée, assurant un lien essentiel avec les coordinateurs et coordinatrices greco des différents départements médicaux.

Vous adaptez votre langage en fonction de vos interlocuteurs et interlocutrices pour vulgariser les termes techniques, challengez les solutions proposées, et collaborez activement avec les parties prenantes pour trouver les adaptations les plus pertinentes.
De plus, vous veillez à la mise à jour et à la rédaction de la documentation nécessaire. Vous mettez à profit votre capacité de synthèse et votre pragmatisme pour mener votre mission dans les délais impartis et garantir un résultat de qualité.
Vous participez activement à l-ensemble des phases d'un projet informatique, de son initialisation à sa finalisation, en vous assurant de produire les livrables attendus à chacune de ces phases. Pour la partie frontend, vous détenez une expertise sur Angular avec la version 20 idéalement.
Vous savez utiliser les outils de collaboration (GIT, JIRA et Confluence) ainsi que les outils de construction Maven et Docker. Une connaissance approfondie des méthodes agiles, notamment Scrum, constitue un atout.
Vous faites preuve d-une excellente capacité relationnelle dans les environnements pluridisciplinaires, alliant communication, vulgarisation des termes techniques et écoute active pour garantir la compréhension des besoins.
Vous savez prendre du recul et tirer parti des retours d'expérience pour progresser. Votre sens de l-initiative est un atout précieux pour le développement de solutions innovantes.
Vous faites preuve d-organisation, d-un bon sens relationnel et d-autonomie dans la recherche de solutions. Par ailleurs, vous avez démontré votre capacité d-initiative et vous souhaitez relever des défis dans un environnement exigeant et de grande technicité.

At Heim, we are reinventing how healthcare is delivered.
We believe that healthcare is best delivered in the home of patients, and that we are at the cusp of a systemic shift away from hospital based care. Our mission is to expand access to in-person clinical care at home by empowering community nurses with technology that makes care delivery more efficient.
We have created an AI native ecosystem that optimises the complex scheduling involved in delivering community based care, and are on track to automate every non clinical touchpoint for nurses.
To date, our technology has powered our network of 400+ practitioners to deliver c. 30K appointments, and we have shown that our algorithms bring down the cost of at-home visits by c.35% whilst freeing up valuable time for care in doing so. We are growing fast and our ambitions are big – with new international markets on the roadmap, and strong investor backing.
Our aim is to create the most productive, AI-enabled distributed clinical workforce working at the intersection of public and private health.By joining Heim, you will play a pivotal role in building the infrastructure that puts clinical care in the home.

s.h: WHAT IT'S LIKE TO WORK AT HEIM
s.t:
We are reinventing how healthcare is delivered. Here are the things that shape your day-to-day:
Meaningful problems – we build systems that improve how organisations understand and care for people. The work is complex, applied, and grounded in real-world patient impact
High standards, low ego – you’ll work alongside thoughtful engineers, clinicians, and operators who care about clarity and good judgement
Speed with intent – we move quickly but deliberately. Clear ownership, evidence-based decisions, outcomes over output
Simple, elegant solutions – we have a strong bias towards code that is easy to reason about, hard to break, and built to outlast the sprint it was born in
Direct access to founders – you’ll have visibility into and input on the direction of the company

This is a full-stack TypeScript role in the truest sense – you will own problems across the entire system, from UI to infrastructure. AI isn’t a feature here; it’s a first principle. We expect you to use agentic coding tools fluently (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) and to be building your own views on where agentic workflows can meaningfully improve what we ship.
You’ll be working on systems where the stakes are real: scheduling errors affect patient care, data quality issues affect clinical decisions, and downtime has consequences. That context sharpens every technical choice you make.

Design and build product features end-to-end across the Heim tech stack – owning them from first principles to production
Architect and implement AI-powered workflows: scheduling optimisation, practitioner dispatch, clinical data enrichment, and agentic referral automations that reduce manual touchpoints for nurses
Own the full lifecycle of features – from TypeScript frontend through to backend services, infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and testing – without relying on separate DevOps or QA teams to close the loop
Build and maintain the APIs, services, and data models that underpin clinical operations – with the reliability and auditability a regulated environment demands
Collaborate with our product and clinical ops teams to translate ambiguous real-world problems into working software
Make pragmatic trade-offs between speed and quality, and advocate clearly when the trade-off isn’t acceptable
Contribute to the architecture and infrastructure decisions that will shape the platform as we scale to NHS Trusts across the UK and into new markets
Leave the codebase better than you found it – improving performance, clarity, and resilience as part of everyday delivery
You won’t get perfectly specified tickets. You’ll be trusted to think, decide, and ship.

Small team, fast loops, few layers – your decisions land fast and the feedback is real
We operate a hybrid team set up, and value high quality in person time so you must be able to commute to our central London office
Technical judgement is respected and expected – you’ll have a real voice in architectural decisions
Disagreement is normal. Good ideas win, not hierarchical ones
Strong bias toward execution: fewer meetings, clear ownership, and decisions grounded in evidence

You’re a senior full-stack engineer who acts like a founder. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks. You’re comfortable roaming an unfamiliar part of the codebase when something needs fixing, and you’ll ask sharp clarifying questions before committing to an approach.

6+ years building and owning production software in fast-moving environments

Proven ability to own the full delivery lifecycle: frontend, backend, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, deployment, and testing – without handing off to separate DevOps or QA teams
Active, fluent use of AI coding tools – Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot – not as novelty, but as default workflow

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

We are hiring a C++/Rust Graphics and Windowing System Software Engineer.
We build Mir – a high-performance, high-efficiency technology stack for window managers, display subsystems and solutions built on top of it, like Ubuntu Frame. Leading with vision, we shape the technology stack that empowers communities to realize a world where apps work seamlessly in every graphical environment.
Our goal is to enable the whole spectrum of graphics from single-purpose screens through edge devices to full desktop environments. We also set the pace for graphics enablement across the Ubuntu certified hardware ecosystem. Our daily drill includes design, development and testing of features as well as working with the community and responding to issues and user inquiries.
Most of the software is written in C++, with support tooling in scripting languages. We will use Rust as an evolutionary step forward. Thus candidates are required to have strong skills in both Rust and C++. We're growing the team and looking for new colleagues who share our passion for precision, performance and user experience.

We are hiring on various career levels with a minimum of 2 years industry experience. We are looking for people who ideally have experience in building window compositing systems or graphics device experience.

We're committed to creating an outstanding developer experience, secure foundations, and easy access to today's most used graphics toolkits and libraries.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to have a meaningful impact on modern display technologies that will impact millions of developers and users. Canonical offers a fast-paced team environment and a career full of learning and development opportunities across the open source spectrum.

About the Opportunity
This isn't a role for someone waiting to be told what to build. We want a true self-starter: endlessly curious, genuinely ambitious, and humble enough to be trusted with real influence.
This person will own our internal systems integrations and the delivery of our MCP layer. You'll keep the lights on while identifying incremental improvements, and build the layer that enables the business to become builders and lets agents do real work safely. You'll spend time in both worlds, often in the same week, sometimes in the same day.
You're an enabler with a high level of ownership, ready to flex whatever muscle the day calls for. An integration breaks — you fix it. The business needs new functionality — you build it. Our MCP layer needs a new connection — you stand it up.
You think beyond the fix. We don't just want someone who keeps integrations running — we want someone who's constantly looking for the opportunity to simplify and consolidate them. You know the difference between patching something and rebuilding it onto better infrastructure, and you have a bias toward leaving every system you touch better than you found it, not just functional.
AI isn't an add-on here — it's how the work gets done. This is an AI-enabled role in an AI-enabled organization. You'll use AI tooling to write code, maintain the environment, and move faster across a wider surface area than one engineer could otherwise cover. It's not a tool you reach for occasionally; it's part of your everyday process.
We're just getting started building the infrastructure that lets everyone in the business become a builder. There's no finished playbook. Our MCP layer doesn't have an established pattern for security, access control, or agent tooling yet — you'll help write it, in partnership with the people who own the roadmap.
What You’ll Own
Back-office integrations — Maintain and enhance the integrations connecting NetSuite, HighJump, our data warehouse, and adjacent systems. Rebuild individual flows onto better infrastructure when it makes sense to, and know the difference between a fix and a rebuild. Go beyond maintenance to actively look for ways to simplify and consolidate our integration landscape — fewer moving parts, less duplicated logic, systems that are easier for the next person to reason about.
Grove Brain / internal MCP layer — Build Grove Brain out from its current early stage into a durable platform other teams build on. Design and implement the connectors and tools that let agents act on real Grove systems.
Security, access, and governance for agents — Help define and build how agents authenticate, what they're allowed to touch, and how that's audited, in partnership with the teams who own security and infrastructure rather than setting policy solo.
Hands-on enablement — Be the person a team calls when they're stuck mid-build on an integration or an agent problem, whether that's a connector, a permissions question, or a "we don't know what's possible yet" question.
Judgment calls — Decide when a systems problem is yours to solve and when it's actually a process problem that belongs to the business.
AI-assisted development — Use AI tooling aggressively as a force multiplier, and hold the line on quality while you do it. You should be moving noticeably faster than an engineer working without these tools, without your standards slipping. More on this below.
Craft, performance, and quality — Own performance, stability and maintainability in the code you ship, at the scale Grove actually runs at.

5+ years building and operating building and maintaining production system integrations — the kind that move data between platforms like NetSuite, HighJump, or similar ERP/WMS systems.
Strong software engineering fundamentals: you can design a pipeline, debug it under pressure, and know the difference between a quick fix and a real one.
Genuine hands-on experience with AI tools and, ideally, agent frameworks or MCP — not just familiarity, but a track record of building with them.
Comfortable operating with a rough direction instead of a finished spec, and you make real progress anyway.
A builder's mindset — you'd rather stand something up yourself than write a design doc for someone else to build.
Enough security instinct to ask the right questions about what an agent should and shouldn't be able to touch, even when you're not the final decision-maker on policy.
You're honest about what you don't know. You can say "I haven't worked with that" without flinching, and you don't paper over the gap with a confident guess.
Background with Airflow, Airbyte, or similar data-pipeline infrastructure
New technology doesn’t scare you. You’ve been dropped into an unfamiliar framework, language, or platform and gotten productive fast, and you can point to a time you did it. You evaluate new tools on the merits instead of defaulting to what you already know or chasing whatever is new.
You’re honest about what you don’t know. You can say “I haven’t worked with that” without flinching, and you don’t paper over the gap with a confident guess.
You’ve taken something vague, made it concrete, brought other people along, and shipped it.
You work well with others. You give direct feedback kindly, you take it well, and people want you on their project.
A real sense of ownership and pride in the experiences you ship and the code you leave behind.
You write things down, and people understand them. You can a non-technical person through a technical tradeoff without hiding behind jargon.
Genuine enthusiasm for Grove’s mission and sustainability values, not just the tech stack.
How We Work Together
This is a high trust environment. You’ll get real scope and real decisions early, and nobody is going to look over your shoulder while you do the work. Trust runs both directions: we’ll be straight with you about the business, the tradeoffs, and the parts of the codebase we aren’t proud of, and we expect that same candor back.
We value psychological safety first and foremost. It’s the precondition for everything else on this list. The teams that solve genuinely hard problems are the ones where people feel safe saying “I don’t understand this yet.”
“I haven’t worked with that” is a complete answer here. We have deep respect for an engineer who names the edge of their own knowledge instead of bluffing past it. We don’t need you to know everything. We need you to be honest about where your expertise begins and ends — and that honesty is worth more to us than a confident guess, in an interview and on the job.

Strong hands-on experience building or operating distributed systems in production.

Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across platform, infrastructure and product engineering teams.

Experience contributing to Kafka or related open source distributed systems.

Experience operating Tier-0 infrastructure at large scale.

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN ’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.
With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way: responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.
Platform Engineering builds what the rest of IREN builds on. We own data engineering, automation, developer tooling, AI enablement, and product engineering, the systems that turn a fleet of data centers and GPU clusters into a platform our customers and our own teams can move quickly on. Much of it is being built now, for the first time, so there is no legacy stack to maintain and no established playbook to follow.
We are hiring senior software engineers across Platform Engineering. This is an individual contributor role. Seniority here is measured by the scope of what you own and by how much better the engineers around you get, not by how many people report to you. At this level you own the design of whole systems, including the parts that cross team boundaries and the parts you will not build yourself.
The part of the role we weight most heavily is what you do for the engineers around you. We expect you to raise the standard of the people you work with, through design review and code review that teach rather than correct, through pairing, and through handing hard problems to engineers who are ready to stretch. We look for evidence of this during the interview, and we continue to assess it after you join.
Because Platform Engineering builds for other teams, the boundaries matter as much as the internals. You will own the interfaces between your systems and everyone else's, negotiate what those contracts guarantee, and manage versioning and compatibility when something has to change.

That work is as much communication as design, so we expect you to write clearly and to be comfortable in a room where people disagree. We also expect depth: senior engineers here are the person the company asks about a particular domain, whether that is data engineering, automation, developer tooling, AI enablement, or product engineering.

Engineers at every level at IREN stay hands on, senior ones included. Responsibilities
Own system design from end to end: the problem statement, architecture, interfaces, data model, and rollout, including the parts other engineers will build.
Coach and develop the engineers around you. Give review that teaches, pair on hard problems, and hand over work that stretches people rather than keeping it because you would finish it faster.
Own the API contracts between your systems and other teams: negotiate what they guarantee, version them, and manage the migration when they change.
Set technical direction for your area, and write it down so other teams can build against it without needing a meeting first.
Break large, ambiguous problems into work that a team can sequence, estimate, and deliver.
Lead delivery across team boundaries, including the coordination and follow up that this actually requires.
Stay hands on. Write and review code, and carry the pager for what you own.
Own operations for your systems: monitoring, on-call, incident response, and the follow up that stops the same incident recurring.
Be the person the company can ask about your domain, and make what you know available to others rather than holding it.
Raise the standard through the systems around the code: CI/CD, observability, testing practice, and documentation.

A record of owning system level design rather than components alone. You have been the person accountable for how a whole system fits together.
Deep experience with distributed systems, including failure modes you have personally debugged rather than only read about.
Demonstrated coaching. Be ready to name engineers who grew because of how you worked with them, and to say what actually changed.
Experience owning APIs that other teams depend on, including versioning and breaking change migrations.
Excellent communication, particularly in writing. You can write a design document another team can act on without a meeting.

We are building a greenfield, document-driven lending platform that automates the full lifecycle of a loan application — from document intake and OCR-based extraction, through human-in-the-loop review, to final approval and downstream submission. The system is a modular monolith with a clear separation between backend services and multiple trust-boundaried web front ends, deployed natively on Azure.
We're looking for a senior full-stack engineer who is equally comfortable designing clean, testable back-end architecture in C#/.NET and building modern, production-grade UI in React/Next.js. You'll work across the stack: domain modeling, API design, background/async processing, and customer- and operations-facing web applications. Responsibilities
Design and build business logic and domain modules in an ASP.NET Core API following Clean Architecture principles (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, API layers).
Build and maintain asynchronous background processing services (a .NET worker) for document-heavy workflows, coordinated through message queues.
Develop and maintain multiple Next.js/React applications serving different user populations (internal operations/back-office tooling and external/customer-facing portals), sharing a common package layer.
Design relational data models and write efficient data access code (EF Core / PostgreSQL).
Integrate with cloud-native infrastructure: message queues, blob storage, secrets management, and managed identity providers.
Implement authentication and authorization across multiple identity boundaries (workforce vs. external/customer identity).
Collaborate on API contracts and shared TypeScript types consumed by front-end applications.
Participate in architectural decisions that keep a growing monolith modular, maintainable, and well-tested (unit, integration, contract, and architecture tests).
Work within a human-in-the-loop product model: build tooling that lets operators review, correct, and approve AI-assisted extraction results, with full traceability of how each data point changed from raw intake to final approval.
Write and maintain automated tests across the stack and participate in CI/CD pipeline health.
Participate in code review, technical design discussions, and mentor less experienced engineers.

8+ years of professional software development experience, with deep expertise in C# / .NET (ASP.NET Core).
4+ years building production front-end applications with React, including Next.js (App Router, server components/actions, route handlers).
Strong understanding of Clean/Layered Architecture, domain modeling, and separation of concerns in non-trivial back-end systems.
Experience with relational databases and ORMs (EF Core or equivalent), including migrations and query performance.
Solid TypeScript skills and comfort working in a monorepo with shared, versioned internal packages.
Experience with cloud infrastructure (Azure preferred; AWS/GCP equivalents considered) — messaging/queues, object storage, secrets management.
Experience implementing or integrating OAuth2/OIDC-based authentication, ideally with enterprise identity providers (e.g., Microsoft Entra ID or similar).
Strong automated testing discipline: unit, integration, and contract testing on both back end and front end.
Comfortable working across the full stack without hand-offs — from database schema to API to UI.
Excellent communication skills and experience working in a small, senior, high-autonomy engineering team.

As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization.

Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.
Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.
Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.
With a global team across 26 offices and 25 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

This is a product that engineers build for engineers, where you’ll see your work directly impact how thousands of developers build software. Expect challenges in data modeling, systems design, developer UX, and secure cloud integrations — all to help engineers and leaders build faster, better, and smarter.

We're looking for a Senior Shopify Developer who balances deep e-commerce expertise with modern frontend engineering. You'll build pixel-perfect, hyper-performant storefronts ranging from custom Liquid themes to headless Hydrogen/Next.js implementations working alongside our design team to create world-class shopping experiences.
In this role, you’ll work across a variety of client projects to find cost-effective, high-quality, and pragmatic solutions to complex e-commerce challenges. Responsibilities will include:
Collaborating closely with Technical Leads and Designers to meet clients' custom e-commerce and technical needs.
Building and maintaining high-performance storefronts using both custom Liquid (Online Store 2.0) and modern headless architectures (Shopify Storefront API, GraphQL, Hydrogen/Remix, Next.js).
Implementing responsive, accessible, and pixel-perfect interfaces based on design specifications, with meticulous attention to product interaction details and motion design.
Integrating custom storefronts with headless CMS platforms (Sanity, Contentful), payment gateways, subscriptions, search, and third-party e-commerce APIs.
Optimizing e-commerce performance, focusing heavily on Core Web Vitals, image/video asset delivery, bundle size, and runtime efficiency across high-traffic collection and product pages.
Architecting scalable, reusable component libraries and design systems tailored for commercial platforms.
Writing clear documentation for store management, custom app integrations, and codebase maintenance.
Participating in project team rituals, including Sprint Planning, daily standups, code reviews, and retrospectives.
The person we’re looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with. They’re flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work “smart”, by carefully managing their workflow and staggering features that have dependencies intelligently. They prefer deep work but are OK coming up to the surface now and then for top level / strategic conversations.
We believe people with backgrounds or interests in design, art, music, food or fashion tend to have a well rounded sense of design & quality, so a variety of hobbies or side projects is a big nice to have!

We’re always pitching for new and exciting technology niches. Some of the areas below are relevant to us!
8+ years writing highly performant frontend code with an obsession for 95+ Lighthouse scores and optimal Core Web Vitals.
Deep Shopify Ecosystem Mastery: Proven experience building custom Shopify themes (Liquid, JSON templates, Online Store 2.0) as well as headless storefronts using the Shopify Storefront API (GraphQL) and frameworks like Hydrogen/Remix or Next.js .
Modern Frontend Tech: Expert-level experience with TypeScript and modern CSS methodologies (Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules) alongside robust animation libraries (GSAP, Framer Motion).
Headless CMS & Integrations: Extensive experience merging Shopify with headless CMS platforms like Sanity, Contentful, or Prismic, as well as third-party services (Klaviyo, Recharge, Algolia/Searchspring, Stripe).
Platform & Hosting: Fluency in industry-standard PaaS platforms including Vercel, Netlify, and Shopify Oxygen.
Architecture & State Management: Experience with state management solutions (Zustand, Redux, Pinia) and API integration patterns for cart state, multi-currency, and checkout flows.
Quality & Accessibility: Experience building accessible (WCAG compliant), responsive interfaces with a strong commitment to SEO best practices, testing frameworks (Jest, Playwright, Cypress), and maintainable code.
Performance Optimization: Practical knowledge of WebSockets, caching strategies (Redis, CDN-level/Cloudflare), and advanced image delivery networks.

Custom App Development: Building bespoke Shopify Apps using Node.js, Remix, GraphQL Admin API, and Shopify CLI.
Shopify Plus & Enterprise Features: Hands-on experience with Shopify Functions, Checkout Branding API, Shopify Scripts, and B2B configurations.
Tracking & Analytics: Setting up server-side tracking, GTM, Meta Pixel, and Customer Privacy APIs without hurting site load times.
WebGL, Canvas & 3D: Experience building interactive graphics, 3D product visualizers, or canvas animations using Three.js or ``.
Full-Stack & API Design: Experience across backend/database layers (PostgreSQL), REST/GraphQL API design, and authentication flows (OAuth, JWT).
Client-Facing & Management: Direct experience working with clients to clarify requirements, defining product roadmaps, or leading engineering teams.

Our pay scale ranges from $40/hr to $120/hr pending seniority (& team leadership experience), and our projects are rarely less than 8 full time weeks at 40 hours per week.
We prefer long standing relationships with highly accountable and communicative team members, so we encourage candidates to expect longer term engagements.
🎤 How we interview
After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.
From there, we’ll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where we’re going as a business.

* Work with external security researchers and auditors, respond to findings and ship fixes.
* Keep backward compatibility for a large installed base while moving the protocol forward.
* Mentor other engineers and help set standards for how we write and review security\-critical code.

* At least 6 years of software engineering, with several years working on network or cryptographic protocols.

* Strong skills in at least one systems language. Rust is a plus.
* Care about the details. In this job, a missing length check is a vulnerability.
* Good written English. German is helpful but not required.

* Experience with formal analysis tools such as Tamarin, ProVerif or TLA\+.
* Familiarity with the Signal protocol, MLS or the Noise framework.
* Published research, CVEs, audit reports or open\-source contributions in security.
* Background in mobile platforms and their constraints, such as push delivery, background limits and battery use.
